analysis.Scope: Historical 1985-2014 only. Raw GCM ensemble means. No ML, tuning, EQM or bias correction.
analysis.Selection: Rank by RMSE ascending within each level; mean of the three level ranks selects Best 3. Equal mean ranks break alphabetically, not by statistical significance.
analysis.Monthly: Ranking compares 12 climatological monthly totals, not all chronological months.
analysis.Metrics: RMSE/MAE: mm. NSE=1-SSE/SST. R2=Pearson correlation squared (not NSE). PBIAS=100*sum(GCM-Station)/sum(Station); positive is overestimation. None is percent correct.
analysis.Dry zero policy: No missing-day imputation. Dash/blank/absent/conflict are missing; trace is observed zero.
analysis.Wet QC: Station gate: missing daily observations <=20% across 1985-2014, followed by complete-month-only totals in every season.
analysis.GCM QC: Finite nonnegative rainfall; known flux units; native-calendar complete monthly intervals; consistent grid/calendar across members; all selected members equal weight; max 3 missing months and none in May-Oct.
analysis.Bounds: Only real bounds are used by default. Missing bounds metadata can inherit units/calendar from time. Short valid submonthly intervals are integrated; gaps, conflicting overlaps or incomplete monthly duration remain invalid.
analysis.Seasons: Wet May-Oct; Dry Nov-Apr labelled by ending year. No months outside Historical added or zero-filled. Even complete monthly data give 30 Wet + 29 Dry = 59 complete seasons.
analysis.Calendar: Native-calendar totals in mm. 360-day and Gregorian months have different durations; no hidden calendar normalization.
analysis.Interpretation: Free-running year-to-year phases need not match observations. High pooled Wet/Dry NSE can reflect the contrast between seasons. Ensemble averaging suppresses variability.
analysis.Validation: Reserved SSP126/245/370/585 from 2015 through the latest genuinely observed date of each station; not executed here.
analysis.Graphs: Top 5 determined separately in each level. Comparison: Top 5 + station. Overview: all GCMs only, no station or observed band.
analysis.SD: Interannual SD of complete station monthly totals; not a confidence interval.
analysis.Deployment: Generated HTML embeds the current result and needs no JSON upload. Hosted results change only after publishing the new generated site.
analysis.Sample minimum: At least 10 years per calendar month, 10 complete annual totals and 20 complete seasonal totals on a common period. Otherwise skip ranking with reports.
